intake.line: A Strong Culture Fit: Prava slides a laminated org chart across the desk and tells Milo he has been retained for Reconciliations; Milo, told for the first time that his forty-one years of optimizing are an asset, says yes before anyone offers him a choice and goes from disoriented to eager.

partition.line: Across the Partition: At his new desk Milo pitches dashboards and low-hanging fruit to Zara, who answers in flat instructions to close only what is in his queue and read every appendix; Milo hears mentorship where there is only courtesy, and decides they are going to be friends.

bell.line: Four Minutes: Milo zeroes Halvard Bell's tenure, initials the form and watches Facilities clear Bell's desk before the coffee finishes dispensing; his pride in the speed curdles slightly when Zara will tell him only that Bell 'goes under', and that night he locks the ledger in his drawer without knowing why.

drawer.line: Four Minutes: Milo zeroes Halvard Bell's tenure, initials the form and watches Facilities clear Bell's desk before the coffee finishes dispensing; his pride in the speed curdles slightly when Zara will tell him only that Bell 'goes under', and that night he locks the ledger in his drawer without knowing why.

summons.line: The Heavy Memo: A memo signed by Edric Thane summons Milo personally; Milo reads it as a career win, and Zara's terse warning to bring nothing, sign nothing and stand if offered a chair is the first time her flatness sounds like fear on his behalf.

corner office.line: Stand: In the cold corner office Edric Thane, hands folded on a closed ledger, calls Milo's speed appetite rather than diligence and says he was retained because he does not ask questions; Milo surprises himself by refusing the chair, his first small act of not complying.

discrepancy.line: A Column No One Explained: Milo unlocks his drawer and finds, in a column no one ever explained, that Bell's tenure was not zeroed but moved; for the first time he turns to Zara with a question instead of a workflow, and she tells him he has now read an appendix and that they have paperwork to do.
